svg.title: Why not give the AI everything? Asked about World War II, handing over every document goes past the model's reading limit, its context window, and the rest is cut off. Handing over a whole chapter that also covers cooking and car repair stays under the limit but adds noise. Handing over just the right chunk gives a high signal-to-noise ratio.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Question: "What happened in World War II?"
